summary: Tested new features: coupons, orders, live tracking, reorder, store follow, and Home follow rail. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering coupons (LATUR10/FRESH50/WELCOME/BAD/below-min), orders (create/get/list, no _id leakage), and catalog regression. Frontend: coupon apply displays 'Coupon LATUR10 −₹20' row and reduces grand total (₹211 → ₹191), Remove Coupon reverts, Checkout navigates to /order/<id> tracking screen with mm:ss ETA countdown, animated rider on SVG map, timeline first step active, items list and Grand total. /orders lists past orders with Track+Reorder; Reorder adds items to cart and briefly shows 'Added'. Store /store/s1 Follow toggles to filled heart 'Following' pastel-pink and persists across reload; Home renders 'Stores you follow' rail with the followed store card. Account → 'My Orders' navigates to /orders. Regression: Home discover chips, categories, buy-again, banners visible; store profile 2x2 media grid with two VIDEO badges + centered logo intact; free-delivery nudge still shown when subtotal < 199.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky Checkout bar (position: absolute, bottom) sits over the coupon Apply button click zone in mobile viewport at some scroll positions. Automated Playwright click on [data-testid=apply-coupon-btn] routed to the checkout-btn (real users may also miss the small Apply target if a bill row scrolls behind). JS .click() works; native tap works when Apply is scrolled into center. Suggest adding scrollView paddingBottom equal to checkoutBar height (~72px) and increasing Apply button hit area / adding a small marginBottom to the coupon card so it is never underlaid by the checkout bar.

issues: Bill row 'Discount −₹17' (MRP savings) sits directly above 'Coupon LATUR10 −₹20' – two 'discount-like' rows in a row can confuse; consider labeling MRP row as 'MRP savings' for clarity.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MEDIUM: Increase Cart ScrollView paddingBottom to ~80 (checkoutBar + tab bar) and/or increase Apply button hitSlop so the sticky Checkout bar never overlays the coupon Apply button. This is the only interaction friction observed.
OPTIONAL: rename Cart bill row 'Discount' to 'MRP savings' to disambiguate from 'Coupon' discount row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:363 – LATUR10 pct discount uses round(subtotal*value/100); for subtotal 150 this returns 15 as required. Fine.
orders endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection {"_id": 0} in list and get.
followed.ts singleton cache + listener pattern is fine but 'cache' is module-scoped and shared across component trees – reload persistence verified via AsyncStorage.
order/[id].tsx uses expo-video (good, not deprecated). Uses react-native-reanimated + react-native-svg for map animation which is acceptable in web preview.
cart.tsx: 'Discount' label refers to MRP savings while 'Coupon LATUR10' is coupon discount – consider renaming.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows verified; minor Apply-btn overlay concern)

seed_data_creation: Test suite created 1 order via POST /api/orders per test-run (retrievable via GET /api/orders/{id}). No seed data pruning performed – acceptable since orders history is a listed feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base is https://ol-components-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Use pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression. For Playwright coupon interactions inside Cart, use JS click (page.evaluate('document.querySelector(...).click()')) to bypass the sticky checkout-bar overlay, OR scroll the Apply button into center first. /orders route is a standalone screen (no bottom tab bar). Follow state persists in AsyncStorage key 'onelatur.followed.v1'.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs. Only observation: sticky Checkout bar can intercept clicks meant for the Apply coupon button when it sits directly below/behind it in the layout. Reproduction: add ≥5 products, open Cart, from natural scroll position tap Apply — a normal Playwright/synthetic click was routed to Checkout. Mitigation: bump ScrollView bottom padding above checkoutBar height and/or slightly raise the coupon card (mb: spacing.md) so Apply is never under the sticky bar.
